meta.note: Established analog sites and candidate sites scored the same way, for the Featured page. Built by validation/benchmarks.ts with app/src/lib/match.
caveats: One procedure for every site: site-scale terrain, vegetation and rock; the 0.5 degree cell's temperature and rainfall; the target's terrain measured in a window of the site's size.
"Best" is the best of all targets, chosen after the fact, and flatters. "Median" is the typical target.
Known analogs are those for which fine-scale data was built. They are a yardstick, not a validation set.
Similarities and scores use the formula, tolerances and weights frozen on 2026-11-14. Nothing was tuned on these sites.
A footprint holds 16 to 256 terrain posts. Small samples.

process.differs: Kawah Ijen is an active, hot, wet system today. Gale's lake is ancient and long dry.
